name: Ultimate WP Slider
author: certainity

sections.description:
Ultimate WP Slider makes it easy to design stunning, responsive, touch-enabled sliders directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Features:
* Add unlimited slides using the media library.
* Per-slide fields: Title, caption, button/link (all optional).
* 3 built-in styles:
* Style 1 – Photo Overlay (text overlaid on image)
* Style 2 – Caption Card (card-style captions)
* Style 3 – Minimal Centered (simple centered text)
* Fully responsive and mobile-friendly.
* Touch-enabled navigation.
* Supports autoplay, loop, pause-on-hover, and bullets/dots.
* Easy-to-use shortcode:
* [ultimate_wp_slider] → display default slider.
* [ultimate_wp_slider id="123"] → display a specific slider.
* [ultimate_wp_slider style="2"] → override global style.
* Works in posts, pages, and widgets.

Why use Ultimate WP Slider?
Unlike bloated slider plugins, this one is lightweight, integrates directly into WordPress, and keeps things simple while looking modern.

👉 View Live Demo
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Click Upload Plugin and choose ultimate-wp-slider.zip from your computer.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to Ultimate WP Slider in the sidebar to create your first slider.
  5. Use [ultimate_wp_slider] shortcode to display it anywhere.
